# Maeen | مَعِين
> Your Daily Source of Quran & Authentic Sunnah (معينك اليومي من القرآن والسنة)

Maeen is a world-class bilingual Islamic platform delivering one Quran page daily with verified tafsir and one authentic Hadith daily.

## Core Principles & Authenticity
- Quran Source: Medina Mushaf text via Quran.com API v4 & Tanzil.net.
- Tafsir Allowed: Tafsir As-Sa'di (تيسير الكريم الرحمن) & Tafsir Ibn Kathir.
- Hadith Sources: Sahih Al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Jami` at-Tirmidhi, Sunan Abu Dawud, An-Nasa'i, Ibn Majah via Sunnah.com API.
- Zero AI-generated text for Quran, Tafsir, or Hadith. All religious content is strictly authenticated.

## Key Endpoints & Routes
- Homepage: https://maeen.app/
- Daily Quran Reader: https://maeen.app/quran
- Daily Hadith: https://maeen.app/hadith
- Quran 604 Pages Journey: https://maeen.app/journey
- Bookmarks & Notes: https://maeen.app/favorites
- Sources & Attribution: https://maeen.app/sources
- About & Methodology: https://maeen.app/about
